mainEntity.name: Does insurance usually cover interior restoration work, or is that only for certain kinds of damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most homeowners with covered interior damage can use insurance-coordinated restoration when the loss is from a covered event such as water, fire, smoke, or storm damage. HH Remodeling LLC serves Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, and Parker, so homeowners in those areas can usually ask whether the job fits their carrier’s claim process.
